 --Cf. ὕω, υἱός, ὑστέρα; Goth. sunus; A.S. sunu (cf. सूनु).
2. सु सु, i. 1, and ii. 2, Par. † To possess power or supremacy (cf. the last).
3. सु सु, i. 1, Par. Ātm. † To go.

4. सु सु (for original वसु, cf. εὖ, ἐΰς; ἐάων = Zend. वङ्ह्व्ãम् = Sskr. *वस्वाम्),
 I. adv. ved. Beautifully,

= Rigv. i. 112, 1.
 II. Very seldom combined and compounded with a verbum finitum; e. g. Pañc. i. d. 205, but cf. Böhtl. Ind.

; but very often with nouns,
 1. Good, well,
. With न, Very badly, Pañc. 199, 24; with मा, In no way,

. More, Śiś. 9, 67; Pañc. 163, 3.
 4. Exceedingly, Śiś. 9, 55.
 5. Consequently, of course.
 --Cf. εὖ.

. To cast, to send.
 2. To incite, to impel.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. सूत.
 1. Sent, dispatched.
 2. Gone, departed, Pañc. 176, 4; see s. v.; see 1. सु with उद्.
 --Cf. perhaps σεύω, σοῦμαι; Lat. sævus.

3. सू सू,
 A. (1. सू),
 I. f. Birth.
 II. As latter part of comp. words,
 1. Bringing forth, yielding; e. g. काम-, adj. Yielding wishes,
. A father. कुमार-, m. A name of Agni, father of Kumāra, the god of war,
. One who has brought forth. जीव-, adj. f. One who has borne a living child,

. f. A mother. विचित्रवीर्य-, f. The mother of Vicitravīrya.
 B. (2. सू), in स-असु-, adj. Having arrows,
